SELECT c.customer_name AS customerName, p.*, CASE WHEN maxv.next_visit_time < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isOverdue FROM sms_so_sales_customer c INNER JOIN sms_so_sales_project p ON c.id = p.customer_id INNER JOIN ( --子查询：每个项目拿到最新一次拜访的下次跟进时间 SELECT project_id, MAX(next_visit_time) AS next_visit_time FROM sms_so_sales_visit GROUP BY project_id ) maxv ON p.id = maxv.project_id
WHERE --只查当前销售领取的客户 c.sale_user_id = #{saleUserId} -- 下次跟进时间：小于等于当前日期+3天（包含逾期的，visitDate已经过去的） AND DATE(maxv.next_visit_time) <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
ORDER BY maxv.next_visit_time ASC
